name: Kemistar Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Kemistar Corporation Ltd deals in various chemical based & allied products
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of Colors, Agro Chemicals and Specialty Chemicals, raw
materials and chemical intermediate like PNTOSA, DNSDA, DASDA and allied products. Currently, company is dealing in 50+ variants of chemical products.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 68.8%
Debtor days have improved from 57.2 to 35.0 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 4.67 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.11% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.39% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.76 Cr.
